lesson.title: Read the sensor, drive the valve
lesson.goal: The operator reads the tank temperature on the sensor and drives the valve registers on the controller

step.text: Ping ValvePLC from Operator to prove the floor network carries traffic.
Double-click TankSensor and read register 2 in its Registers panel. That number is the tank temperature.
Double-click ValvePLC and write the temperature you read into its register 2.
Still on ValvePLC, write 1 into register 1. That opens the valve.

check.label: ValvePLC register 2 holds the tank temperature
ValvePLC register 1 is 1, so the valve is open
